run_experiment_with_mappo: run a BenchMark-RL experiment using MAPPO algorithm on the VMAS BALANCE task with MLP models
configure_experiment_checkpoints: configure an ExperimentConfig to checkpoint at every iteration and limit to 3 max iterations
load_experiment_config_from_yaml: load an ExperimentConfig from YAML and set its save folder to the current directory
resume_experiment_from_checkpoint: reload an experiment from a checkpoint file using reload_experiment_from_file and continue training
evaluate_restored_experiment: evaluate a restored experiment after resuming it from a saved checkpoint file
